images.alt: Three-by-three grid of spooky painted minis on black: Ghost Rider, Carnage, Werewolf by Night, Hela, Venom, a Tomb Kings Tomb Guardian, Blade, Sauron and Hush
Ghost Rider with a flaming skull and chain, riding his fire-trailing motorcycle
Red, tendril-covered Carnage lunging on a sandy base
Shaggy brown Werewolf by Night in green pants, claws raised and fangs bared
Hela in black and green with her antlered headdress, on a pale base
Venom crouched with his long red tongue out, white spider emblem on black
Blood Bowl Tomb Guardian, a mummy in black and gold armor hefting a stone block
Blade in sunglasses and a long grey coat, gripping a bloodied sword
Green winged Sauron with purple shorts, swooping over a rocky base
Bandage-wrapped Hush in a brown trench coat on a broken stone base
